import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

TR = 32
LH = 32
P = 12
HID = 32
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.Z = Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.trunk1 = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, TR, 1)
        self.trunk2 = nn.Conv2d(TR, TR, 3, padding=1)
        self.l1 = nn.Conv2d(7 + Z + TR, LH, 1)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(LH, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P * Z, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TR + 2 * P * Z, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.register_buffer("lpos", torch.eye(Z))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        t = F.relu(self.trunk1(obs))
        t = F.relu(t + self.trunk2(t))
        per = torch.stack([obs[:, 0:Z], obs[:, Z:2 * Z], obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z], obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]], dim=2)
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        pos = self.lpos.view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        tt = t.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, TR, Y, X)
        h = torch.cat([per, gl, pos, tt], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 7 + Z + TR, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.l1(h))
        q = self.l2(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = q, q, q
            else:
                qp = F.pad(q, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(qp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-qp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(qp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            u = torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1).reshape(B, Z * 3 * P, Y, X)
            res.append(out(F.relu(mix(u))))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        ql = q.reshape(B, Z * P, Y, X)
        g = torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3)), ql.mean((2, 3)), ql.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.0007, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
W = 32
HH = 64
G = 64


class Res(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)

    def forward(self, x):
        return F.relu(x + self.c2(F.relu(self.c1(x))))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.n_types = int(spec.n_types)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.b1 = Res(W)
        self.b2 = Res(W)
        self.h1 = nn.Conv2d(W, HH, 1)
        self.h2 = nn.Conv2d(HH, self.n_types, 3, padding=1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.h2.weight.view(self.n_types, -1), 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.h2.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        f = self.b2(self.b1(s))
        place = self.h2(F.relu(self.h1(f))).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DK = 8
G = 64


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.dproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, DK, 1)
        self.dense = nn.Linear(DK * Y * X + G, int(spec.n_actions))
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.dense.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.dense.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        base = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        d = F.relu(self.dproj(f)).flatten(1)
        dense = self.dense(torch.cat([d, g], dim=1))
        return base + dense, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
D = 16
G = 64
LOC_SCALE = 8.0


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        A = int(spec.n_actions)
        N = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.vproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, D, 1)
        self.loc = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N, A))
        self.wout = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(D, A))
        nn.init.normal_(self.wout, std=0.1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.gout = nn.Linear(G, A)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.gout.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.gout.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        v = F.relu(self.vproj(f)).flatten(2)
        att = torch.softmax(self.loc * LOC_SCALE, dim=0)
        r = torch.matmul(v, att)
        logits = (r * self.wout.unsqueeze(0)).sum(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = logits + self.gout(g)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.9}

CELL = 64
CTX = 32
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.cell1 = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, CELL, 1)
        self.cell2 = nn.Conv2d(CELL, CELL, 1)
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(CELL, CTX, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(CELL + CTX, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix1 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.mix2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (CELL + CTX), G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        c = F.relu(self.cell1(obs))
        c = F.relu(self.cell2(c))
        k = F.relu(self.ctx(c))
        feat = torch.cat([c, k], dim=1)
        p = self.proj(feat)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), m1, m2, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix1, self.mix2, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(m1(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            h = F.relu(m2(h))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([feat.mean((2, 3)), feat.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.92}

TR = 32
LH = 48
P = 16
HID = 32
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.Z = Z
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.trunk1 = nn.Conv2d(int(spec.in_channels) + self.T, TR, 1)
        self.trunk2 = nn.Conv2d(TR, TR, 3, padding=1)
        self.l1 = nn.Conv2d(11 + Z + TR, LH, 1)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(LH, P, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.uout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.sout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.uout:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * TR + 2 * P * Z, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.register_buffer("lpos", torch.eye(Z))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        t = F.relu(self.trunk1(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1)))
        t = F.relu(t + self.trunk2(t))
        bld = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        mis = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        ext = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        one = torch.ones_like(bld[:, 0:1])
        zero = torch.zeros_like(bld[:, 0:1])
        bb = torch.cat([one, bld[:, :Z - 1]], dim=1)
        tb = torch.cat([one, tgt[:, :Z - 1]], dim=1)
        ba = torch.cat([bld[:, 1:], zero], dim=1)
        ta = torch.cat([tgt[:, 1:], zero], dim=1)
        per = torch.stack([bld, tgt, mis, ext, bb, tb, ba, ta], dim=2)
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        pos = self.lpos.view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        tt = t.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, TR, Y, X)
        h = torch.cat([per, gl, pos, tt], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 11 + Z + TR, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.l1(h))
        q = self.l2(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, uo, so in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.uout, self.sout):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = q, q, q
            else:
                qp = F.pad(q, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(qp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-qp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(qp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            hh = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            u = uo(hh).reshape(B, Z, Y, X)
            s = so(hh).reshape(B, Z, Y, X)
            res.append((torch.softmax(s, dim=1) * u).sum(1, keepdim=True))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        ql = q.reshape(B, Z * P, Y, X)
        g = torch.cat([t.mean((2, 3)), t.amax((2, 3)), ql.mean((2, 3)), ql.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(g)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

WIDTH = 40

HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):

            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:

            else:

                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))

        self.T = int(spec.n_types)

            nn.Conv2d(int(spec.in_channels) + self.T, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.0007, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.92}

STEM = 64
D = 48
FF = 96
HEADS = 4
NL = 2
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
G = 64


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.att = nn.MultiheadAttention(D, HEADS, batch_first=True)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(D, FF), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(FF, D))

    def forward(self, x):
        y = self.n1(x)
        x = x + self.att(y, y, y, need_weights=False)[0]
        return x + self.ff(self.n2(x))


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(int(spec.in_channels) + self.T + 2, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, D, 1))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, Y * X, D))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block() for _ in range(NL)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(1, 1, Y, X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(1, 1, Y, X)
        self.register_buffer("coords", torch.cat([ys, xs], dim=1).clone())

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        cc = self.coords.expand(B, 2, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m, cc], dim=1))
        tok = s.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            tok = blk(tok)
        tok = self.nf(tok)
        f = F.relu(tok.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There is only one result so far. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so I can't separate network problems from recipe problems yet. The default recipe allows only 131k steps, which is about 32 PPO updates of 4,096 samples. That is very few updates for a 257-action policy that must build exactly. Two levers look most promising. First, the recipe: fewer epochs buy more samples, and smaller batches give more updates. Second, an inductive bias in the network: whether a placement is correct depends on per-layer facts inside the brick's footprint (where it lands, whether the landing cells are all missing, whether it seals missing cells below). The starting network blends all the layers together in its first 1x1 convolution. This round separates the two levers: (A) the starting network with a new recipe, (B) a layer-resolved footprint head with the same recipe, (C) the same head with a 1-epoch recipe that buys more samples.
analyses.2: Every trial so far scored 0.000 on dev, and training success in the last 10% of steps was also 0. That includes the start architecture with the default recipe, 2 and 1 PPO epochs, and the layer-resolved head. So the results do not rank any of these choices. One thing stands out: the round-1 recipes used minibatches of 256, so they gave about 1.6k–1.8k gradient steps, compared with about 4.1k for the default recipe. More samples may not help if the number of optimiser steps is what limits learning. Two other things may slow early learning: policy outputs that start at default scale, and a head that assumes a top-left anchor and a known channel layout, which may not hold if this world differs from its description. This round mixes recipe and network changes: many small-minibatch gradient steps, near-uniform initial policies, and one head with no assumptions about anchors or channels.
analyses.3: Six trials covered recipe changes (1–3 epochs, 2k–8k gradient steps, 160k–426k samples), a layer-resolved footprint head and a generic 3x3 per-type head. All scored exactly 0 on dev and 0 on training success. Seed noise cannot explain this, and no recipe change made any difference. Small designs of 6 bricks need only greedy placements that land correctly, which a footprint-pooling head can represent. Failing every time at 400k samples points to something systematic. One possibility is that the action-index layout differs from the description: a transpose, position-major order, or DONE at another index. That would break every convolutional logit head equally. This round tests that with two heads that learn the layout (a dense hedge and learned positional attention per action). The third candidate is a cleaner structured net that assumes the described world. If only the layout-learning heads score above 0, the action layout is the bottleneck.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored 0 on both seeds, and every one also had 0 training success in its last 10%. The changes covered recipe (1 to 3 epochs, 32 to about 6.6k gradient steps, 160k to 426k steps), head shape (footprint pooling, layer-resolved, plain 3x3 conv, dense, learned attention per action) and output initialisation. None of them made a difference, so no one factor shows up as the bottleneck. Hedges for an unexpected action layout (dense head, attention head) also stayed at 0, which weakly argues against a layout twist. One untested explanation is that the agent never learns to place exactly enough to build a whole design. A per-action computation that finds the landing layer and checks the target at that layer may be the missing piece. Other untested levers are: the mask as an input feature, higher gamma and lambda with larger lr and more updates, and global attention for ordering. With 3 trials left, I am making three different bets.
